headline: Lease with News Café for Broad Street parking lot, easement with Narragansett Electric at 100 Freight Street, and pay rate ordinance for Local 3960.
summary: The agenda includes a six-month lease followed by month-to-month tenancy for a Broad Street parking lot, and an underground utility easement at 100 Freight Street. It also includes a pay rate ordinance, claims for damages, correspondence, and confirmation of appointments.
items: Correspondence: Town of Exeter resolutions on dam Emergency Action Plan requirements
Correspondence: Blackstone Center, 1 Moshassuck St. Q3 2026 construction update
Correspondence: Pawtucket High School construction report
Correspondence: RI Energy response on problems on Smithfield Avenue
Correspondence: Public Works response on Rice Street crosswalk
Correspondence: two communications on the collective bargaining agreement between the Pawtucket School Committee and the Pawtucket Teachers Alliance, Local 930
Ordinance on pay rates for Local 3960 (Finance & Grant Compliance Assistant), to be laid on the table and referred to the Finance Committee
Claims referred to the Committee on Claims and Pending Suits: Napoleon Gonsalves, $275.00 (pothole); Nicholas Jensen, $315.98 (pothole)
Claims referred to the Law Department and RI Interlocal Trust: Mauricio Rueda, $3,994.00 (property damage); Lynn Farinelli, $500,000.00 and $100,000.00 (claim for relief)
Communication from Councilor Mark Wildenhain to Mayor Donald R. Grebien (Hasbro)
Confirmation of Ann Marie Braganca to the Parks Commission
Confirmation of Dorine Havandjian to the Advisory Commission on Arts and Culture
Confirmation of Suzette Wordell to the Advisory Commission on Arts and Culture
Confirmation of Michael William Cooper to the Pension Board
Reappointment of Lydia Perez to the Public Arts Fund Committee
Resolution authorizing a six-month lease, then month-to-month tenancy, with Joshua Café, LLC d/b/a News Café for the parking area lot fronting on Broad Street and North Union Street
Resolution authorizing an easement agreement with Narragansett Electric Company to maintain an underground distribution system at 100 Freight Street (Assessor's Plat 8, Lot 417)
Ordinance for second passage repealing and replacing the pay rate schedule for Local 3960 in Section §88-12, adding Parking Enforcement Officer
location: City Council Chambers, Pawtucket Municipal Annex, 100 Freight Street
